searchText: Incase folks are interested, I did a basic chain scan to see what contracts use things like ecrecover/bn254 etc. vibe coded a frontend here to display the data: https://kevaundray.github.io/pq-chain-analysis/#0x6b175474e89094c44da98b954eedeac495271d0f The DAI example linked is not as bad as it seems, ecrecover is only used in permit. So it just means that you should cancel your allowances before migrating over to PQ pq tx sigs breakout #18: https://forkcast.org/calls/pqts/018/?summary=notes
